sar.narrative: This report details an undocumented coordinated fraud pattern under internal case AC-HHF-005. The suspicious activity involves customer C00348 and debit card C00348-K1. Between 2017-01-07 and 2017-01-28, six online micro-charges under product code C occurred on card C00348-K1: transaction 3660245 on 2017-01-07 at 15:32 for $4.30 in region 325.0, transaction 3660246 on 2017-01-15 at 22:51 for $5.08 in region 264.0, transaction 3660247 on 2017-01-16 at 14:04 for $2.70 in region 264.0, transaction 3660248 on 2017-01-18 at 19:30 for $4.94 in region 264.0, transaction 3660249 on 2017-01-20 at 11:03 for $2.10 in region 264.0, and transaction 3660250 on 2017-01-28 at 20:45 for $4.05 in region 264.0. Customer C00348 reported non-authorization of transaction 3660250 when the case opened on 2017-01-28. Institutional graph analysis linked these six transactions to a coordinated low-and-slow micro-charge skimming ring affecting 17 total cards during the January 2017 wave. This pattern of small online charges is inconsistent with the cardholder's baseline prior to opening of 149 transactions with a median amount of $58.98 and a maximum amount of $774.08. No prior suspicious activity report has been filed on this card, and OFAC screening of the customer and card identifiers against the SDN list returned no match. The agent opened internal case AC-HHF-005, set connected cards to monitoring, and escalated the case to an analyst; a block of card C00348-K1 is recommended and awaits team-lead approval, and this filing is recommended and awaits fraud-manager approval, covering a total exposure of $23.17.
